steps.sql: CREATE TABLE cf_event_outbox (event_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin PRIMARY KEY,sequence BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,stream VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,schema_version INT NOT NULL,payload LONGTEXT NOT NULL,created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,audit_state VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,resource_state VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,resource_owner VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET ascii NULL,resource_expiry DATETIME(6) NULL,resource_epoch BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,resource_attempts INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,resource_next_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,resource_error VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NULL,search_state VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,search_owner VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET ascii NULL,search_expiry DATETIME(6) NULL,search_epoch BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,search_attempts INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,search_next_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,search_error VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NULL,UNIQUE KEY outbox_sequence(sequence),KEY outbox_resource(resource_state,resource_next_at,resource_expiry,sequence),KEY outbox_search(search_state,search_next_at,search_expiry,sequence)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
